paper_title: New Exclusion Limit for Dark Photons from an SRF Cavity-Based Search (Dark SRF)
notes: Light-shining-through-wall (LSW) dark photon search with two 1.3 GHz SRF cavities; not a dark-matter search so no density dependence. Curve is the blue 95% C.L. observed exclusion boundary (region above excluded) from Fig. 4, extracted as vector strokes from e-print file run0result_01242023_ZL.pdf (blue RGB 0.192,0.388,0.808, fill=None). Axis calibration from tick labels: log-x m_gamma' 1e-7..1e-5 eV, log-y epsilon 1e-9..1e-6, frame 80.3-645.2 (x), 61.4-410.6 (y) px. The wedge dips to a minimum epsilon=1.7e-9 at m~5.4e-6 eV, the cavity resonance mass (f0=1.298 GHz -> 5.37e-6 eV); matches the abstract's stated best limit epsilon=1.6e-9. Abstract quotes world's-best range 2.1e-7 - 5.7e-6 eV; the extracted boundary extends slightly beyond on both sides where the blue curve is drawn (down to the left frame edge ~4e-8 eV and up the steep right branch to ~7e-6 eV where it exits the top of the plot). Two off-frame vertices at m<4e-8 eV (clamped to the top edge) were dropped. y-variable is the kinetic mixing chi (= epsilon in the paper).
